candidates: Each new Sphinx Gallery section directory added under `examples/` must include a `README.rst` with at minimum a valid reStructuredText section title (e.g., `My Section\n============`). An empty or title-less `README.rst` causes `<no title>` labels on gallery navigation buttons and leaves the section entry blank on the overall gallery index page.

When adding a new Sphinx Gallery section under `examples/`, preview the rendered gallery index page (e.g., in a CI artifacts build) to confirm the section appears in the intended position; new sections should not be inserted before foundational sections such as the introduction.
